summary: Contestants demonstrate foundational knowledge of marketing and sales concepts by completing an objective test. Topics include market research, target market analysis, pricing strategies, promotional planning, consumer behavior, and sales processes. The event is open to any secondary or postsecondary division contestant.
time_limits: no more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
what_to_bring: (Optional) Cordless calculator: Electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards. See NLC Calculator Guidelines.
competencies: Demonstrate understanding of core marketing principles, including the marketing mix, branding, and the role of marketing in the global business environment
Analyze target markets and consumer behavior using demographic, psychographic, and buying behavior data, and interpret market research findings to support informed Marketing & Sales decisions
Develop and evaluate pricing strategies based on cost, competition, and customer value

Apply knowledge of integrated marketing communications across digital and traditional channels, including social media platforms, influencer marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), email marketing, content marketing, pay-per-click advertising, and promotional strategies to build brand awareness and engage target audiences
Understand sales processes and techniques, including prospecting, presenting, handling objections, closing, and building long-term customer relationships
Apply ethical, legal, and socially responsible practices in all Marketing & Sales activities
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this objective event.
